questions.description: 集合实现多列表并集去重。
questions.code_template:
lists = [[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]]
all_items = set()
for lst in lists:
    all_items.update(lst)
print('All:',___)
questions.solution:
lists = [[1, 2], [2, 3], [3, 4]]
all_items = set()
for lst in lists:
    all_items.update(lst)
print('All:', sorted(all_items))

print(___)
questions.solution:
def filter_stopwords(words, stopwords):
    stop = set(stopwords)
    return [w for w in words if w not in stop]

print(filter_stopwords(["a", "the", "cat"], ["a", "the"]))
